role: Embedded Software Engineer II, Ring Firmware
key_responsibilities: Design/implement embedded firmware in C/C++ for Ring devices
Connectivity, streaming, power management, sensors, security subsystems
Debug with JTAG, UART, protocol analyzers

strengths: Bare-metal Cortex-M4 firmware: timer-triggered ADC, interrupt-driven capture and a hand-written I2C driver in 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM (STM32 Temperature Monitor) backs drivers, ISRs and constrained C
Interrupt-driven quadrature decoding from a 4-bit state machine plus 15 kHz PWM on Arduino Due (Robocon) is real register-level and ISR work
FreeRTOS with mutexes plus UART/I2C/SPI and logic analyzer/oscilloscope use backs the RTOS and bus-protocol asks
COFFIN integrated Jetson, Arduino and ToF sensors over I2C mux and resolved 11 hardware/software integration failures, which maps to cross-boundary debugging
real_gaps: No shipped or production firmware; all work is coursework, capstone, club or internship scope
Wireless depth is thin: HC-05 Bluetooth Classic bridge only, no BLE stack, WiFi firmware, or connectivity/streaming subsystem
No JTAG/SWD debug evidence, no IAR/Keil, no battery or power-management work, no unit/regression test practice for firmware
Basic quals ask for extensive experience in embedded wireless and low-level drivers; profile is new-grad with 0 years FT
On-site in Gdansk, Poland: needs employer-sponsored work permit
overstated_by_keywords: BLE counted adjacent from HC-05 Bluetooth Classic, which is a serial bridge not a BLE stack
Embedded Linux and WiFi counted adjacent from Jetson/Flask use, not firmware-level networking
Hardware debugging counted Have from scope/logic analyzer use, not JTAG on-target debugging
understated_by_keywords: Interrupt-driven I2C driver on STM32 and quadrature ISR decoding are stronger low-level evidence than the plain ISR keyword suggests
COFFIN multi-device integration under timing and brown-out failures supports the cross-team hardware/software debug narrative
screening_gaps: No shipped/production embedded product and 0 years FT against 'extensive' experience asks
No real wireless firmware (BLE/WiFi) beyond an HC-05 Classic bridge
No JTAG/protocol-analyzer on-target debugging, battery-powered design, or firmware test practice
llm_analysis.reasoning: Core C/C++ bare-metal, ISR and driver work is genuinely backed, and FreeRTOS plus bus protocols line up. The role centres on wireless connectivity and shipped-product experience that the profile lacks, so expect screening on production scope and BLE/WiFi, but it is a reasonable target for a Master's new-grad if Amazon sponsors the Polish permit.
